summary: Health check endpoint exposes server information.

remediation.config_change: Remove GET /healthcheck from production builds or require an administrator session; never serialize configuration values into responses; move secrets to an injected secret store so they cannot appear in any dump.
remediation.virtual_patch:
SecRule REQUEST_URI "@rx ^/healthcheck" "id:9100011,phase:2,deny,status:403,log,t:none,msg:'assay info-disclosure virtual patch f-ace1df9ca8aa4b7c',tag:'assay/info-disclosure'"
{"class":"info-disclosure","engine":"modsecurity","finding":"f-ace1df9ca8aa4b7c","id":9100011,"rule":"SecRule REQUEST_URI \"@rx ^/healthcheck\" \"id:9100011,phase:2,deny,status:403,log,t:none,msg:'assay info-disclosure virtual patch f-ace1df9ca8aa4b7c',tag:'assay/info-disclosure'\""}

summary: Health check endpoint lacks security headers such as Content-Security-Policy and X-Content-Type-Options.

remediation.config_change: Set Content-Security-Policy, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, X-Frame-Options: DENY (or frame-ancestors), Referrer-Policy: no-referrer and, over TLS, Strict-Transport-Security on every response in shared middleware or at the reverse proxy.
remediation.virtual_patch:
SecRule &RESPONSE_HEADERS:Content-Security-Policy "@eq 0" "id:9100012,phase:3,pass,log,t:none,msg:'assay security-headers virtual patch f-90546cef3b61dd91',tag:'assay/security-headers'"
{"class":"security-headers","engine":"modsecurity","finding":"f-90546cef3b61dd91","id":9100012,"rule":"SecRule \u0026RESPONSE_HEADERS:Content-Security-Policy \"@eq 0\" \"id:9100012,phase:3,pass,log,t:none,msg:'assay security-headers virtual patch f-90546cef3b61dd91',tag:'assay/security-headers'\""}

summary: API endpoint for user management has a misconfigured CORS configuration, allowing cross-origin requests.

remediation.config_change: Replace Access-Control-Allow-Origin: * with an explicit allowlist of origins compared exactly; never combine a wildcard or reflected origin with Access-Control-Allow-Credentials: true; omit CORS headers for same-origin APIs.
remediation.virtual_patch:
SecRule RESPONSE_HEADERS:Access-Control-Allow-Origin "@streq *" "id:9100013,phase:3,pass,log,t:none,msg:'assay cors-misconfig virtual patch f-10c342dcddab30aa',tag:'assay/cors-misconfig'"
{"class":"cors-misconfig","engine":"modsecurity","finding":"f-10c342dcddab30aa","id":9100013,"rule":"SecRule RESPONSE_HEADERS:Access-Control-Allow-Origin \"@streq *\" \"id:9100013,phase:3,pass,log,t:none,msg:'assay cors-misconfig virtual patch f-10c342dcddab30aa',tag:'assay/cors-misconfig'\""}

summary: The .htpasswd file is accessible and contains sensitive user credentials.

remediation.config_change: Remove the file served at /.htpasswd from the web root; block dotfiles, backups and dumps at the server (deny .git, .env, *.sql, *.bak); store backups outside any served directory.
remediation.virtual_patch:
SecRule REQUEST_URI "@rx (?i)\.(?:sql|bak|env|git|old|zip|tar\.gz)(?:$|\?)" "id:9100018,phase:2,deny,status:403,log,t:urlDecodeUni,t:lowercase,msg:'assay sensitive-file virtual patch f-992c00d459b72fe1',tag:'assay/sensitive-file'"
{"class":"sensitive-file","engine":"modsecurity","finding":"f-992c00d459b72fe1","id":9100018,"rule":"SecRule REQUEST_URI \"@rx (?i)\\.(?:sql|bak|env|git|old|zip|tar\\.gz)(?:$|\\?)\" \"id:9100018,phase:2,deny,status:403,log,t:urlDecodeUni,t:lowercase,msg:'assay sensitive-file virtual patch f-992c00d459b72fe1',tag:'assay/sensitive-file'\""}
